info.title: DeliGo Food Delivery API
info.description:
REST API for the DeliGo food delivery platform, covering customer ordering, vendor/product management, delivery-partner and fleet operations, payments (RedUniq), admin/permission management, analytics, and supporting services.

### Authentication
Most endpoints require a JSON Web Token. The token can be supplied either as:
- `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` header, or
- `accessToken` httpOnly cookie (set automatically on login)

Role-based access control is enforced per-route (e.g. `CUSTOMER`, `VENDOR`, `SUB_VENDOR`, `ADMIN`, `SUPER_ADMIN`, `FLEET_MANAGER`, `DELIVERY_PARTNER`). Some `ADMIN` routes additionally require fine-grained permission strings; this is noted in the endpoint description where applicable. `SUPER_ADMIN` implicitly bypasses role checks.

### Response envelope
All successful responses share this shape:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "string (optional, localized)", "meta": { "total": 0, "page": 1, "limit": 10, "totalPage": 1 }, "data": {} }
```
`meta` is only present on paginated list endpoints.

### Error envelope
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "string", "errorSources": [ { "path": "string", "message": "string" } ], "err": {}, "stack": "string (development only)" }
```

post.summary: RedUniq payment gateway webhook/notification callback

schema.description: Gateway-defined webhook payload; shape controlled by RedUniq. Commonly includes order.ref / ref / transaction.ref (maps to checkoutSummaryId) and token / transaction.token.
